# netbox_device_console_server_port (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/consoleserverport/):

> A console server is a device which provides remote access to the local consoles of connected devices. They are typically used to provide remote out-of-band access to network devices, and generally connect to console ports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Note that some terraform code is not included in the example for brevity

resource "netbox_device" "test" {
  name           = "%[1]s"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.test.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.test.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.test.id
}

resource "netbox_device_console_server_port" "test" {
  device_id      = netbox_device.test.id
  name           = "console server port"
  type           = "de-9"
  speed          = 1200
  mark_connected = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the device console server port.
- `name` (String) The name of the device console server port.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the device console server port.
- `label` (String) The label of the device console server port.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Whether the device console server port is marked as connected even without a cable. Defaults to `false`.
- `module_id` (Number) The ID of the module associated with the device console server port.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the device console server port.
- `speed` (Number) One of [1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, 115200].
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `type` (String) One of [de-9, db-25, rj-11, rj-12, rj-45, mini-din-8, usb-a, usb-b, usb-c, usb-mini-a, usb-mini-b, usb-micro-a, usb-micro-b, usb-micro-ab, other].

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_device_console_server_port.example 1
```
